name: three_men_in_cave
title: Three Men Were Trapped in a Cave
source: Sahih al-Bukhari 2272; Sahih Muslim 2743. Verify citations before publication.

audio.narration: Record or synthesize a calm, clear narration. Keep speech intelligible and avoid imitating a real reciter.
audio.music: Use a restrained, license-cleared atmospheric bed or environmental soundscape. Avoid overpowering the narration.
audio.mix: Target narration around -3 dBFS peak; duck the bed by 8-12 dB during speech; check the final WAV/MP4 with ffprobe.

scenes.text: Three men entered a cave to escape the rain.
scenes.vo: Three men entered a cave to escape the pouring rain.
Suddenly, a massive boulder fell and sealed the entrance.

scenes.text: There was no human way out.
scenes.vo: They tried to move it, but it would not budge.

scenes.text: They called upon Allah through sincere deeds.
scenes.vo: They called upon Allah through the righteous deeds they had done sincerely.
The first remembered honoring his elderly parents.

scenes.text: One left sin for Allah's sake.
scenes.vo: The second remembered leaving a sinful act for the sake of Allah.
The third remembered faithfully returning what had been entrusted to him.
With every sincere supplication, the rock moved until they walked out into the light.
